title: Attestree
description: Deployment control plane for Windows fleets: every winget package is detonated in a sandbox at ingest, given an observed SBOM and attested with a signed in-toto statement before it rolls out in rings from the operator’s own fenced winget feed. Open-core, with a free Community Edition.

title: Enterprise Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure
description: Modernising the Microsoft infrastructure of an international industrial company: migrating messaging and telephony to Exchange Online and Teams, an automated endpoint compliance and BIOS lifecycle platform, hybrid identity automation and a central SIEM platform on the Elastic Stack.

title: SmallCapTrader
description: Full-stack trading platform with several strategies, a beam-search rule-mining engine for automated strategy discovery, and a dual-mode architecture (monolithic or sharded) with multi-broker execution.

title: options-gex
description: Gamma-exposure research engine for options trading: pulls historical option chains, computes GEX locally and backtests level-driven rules against baselines, behind a multi-condition statistical gate that must pass before any live execution.

title: Enterprise SaaS Platform — CI/CD
description: Infrastructure-as-Code and deployment automation for an enterprise SaaS platform: a CI/CD pipeline for reproducible multi-environment deployments and technical lead on customer implementations.
